messages:
Ana: Quick flag 1: CedarBridge p95 token latency drifted +280ms during their nightly bulk job (02:10-02:25 UTC). Renewal touchpoint in 4 days, want to propose a low-risk perf plan.
Diego: Do we know model + invocation mix?
Ana: They use redwood/dialogue-v1 for non-streaming generation, median input ~240 tokens, median output ~110 tokens, occasional parallel batch jobs from their CRM sync.
Liam: Trace peek: batch spikes >5 correlate with queue latency. No OOMs.
Ana: Proposed quick plan: 1) enable int8 quant profile on their dedicated pool, 2) route 12% traffic to redwood/trim-latency-v1:int8 as a canary, 3) keep 8% hosted fallback.
Mira (CedarBridge): Concerned about exact phrasing for legal templates. Need an eval of 8 core templates before swap.
Diego: We'll run eval set (8 templates) and run automated diff + one human QA pass. Rollback on semantic drift or p95 > baseline + 180ms for 10m.
Liam: Ops tuning: lower continuous_batch_size_limit from 64 -> 48 for their pool during the canary, set kv-prefetch TTL=60s to avoid cache churn. Also pre-allocate +1 GPU for first 2h.
Ana: Canary route snippet:
```
route: cedarbridge-latency-canary
- match: customer_id == "cedarbridge"
- weight: 12
- model: redwood/trim-latency-v1:int8
- pool: dedicated-cb-01
- fallback: hosted
- autoscale_headroom: 0.22
- continuous_batch_size_limit: 48
```
watchdog-bot: Canary scheduled: cedarbridge-canary-4441239876; monitors: p95_tokens, error_rate, semantic_regression. Auto-revert: if p95 > baseline+180ms for 10m OR semantic_failures >=1 -> revert to redwood/dialogue-v1.
Mira (CedarBridge): Thanks  Please include our QA on the eval run and loop back after 2h.
Ana: Will do. Action items: Ana run eval + invite QA, Diego & Liam deploy canary + pool limits, watchdog-bot monitor & auto-revert. Will post results here after the window. :white_check_mark:
